title: Application of chapter.
bodyText: This chapter applies to registrations of securities in beneficiary form made before or after April 29, 1998, by decedents dying on or after April 29, 1998.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "April 29, 1998" substituted for "the effective date of this Act".

bodyHtml:
[§539-12]  Application of chapter.  This chapter applies to registrations of securities in beneficiary form made before or after April 29, 1998, by decedents dying on or after April 29, 1998. [L 1998, c 63, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "April 29, 1998" substituted for "the effective date of this Act".
